flags16.name: Item Flags
flags16.tooltip: Item flags, OR-ed by place/update functions. Same offset as Projectile.RuntimeFlags in the old ObjectOffset (projectiles do not have the item component).

uint32.name: Holder Unit
uint32.tooltip: Handle of the unit that carries the item, set on the tick it is taken and 0xFFFFFFFF when dropped (A14 sec. 5.6). ParentHandle only follows ~9 ticks later. R15 W1 init=0xffffffff W:item_init

uint32.name: Item Self Handle
uint32.tooltip: Written from param_1 in item_init (R15-ish reads elsewhere): probably the item's own handle.
